newsitem.title: USA: CNG says to focus on Energy Services unit.
newsitem.headline: CNG says to focus on Energy Services unit.

text.p: Consolidated Natural Gas Co said it will focus on improving its Energy Services Corp's performance in 1997.
The company said the pretax operating loss at its energy marketing services segment was "the only disappointment of the year" (fiscal 1996). It did not give details.
Officials at the company were not immediately available to comment further.
The company said the unit already has committments for selling as much power in 1997 as it did in 1996.

Later in the day, a CNG spokesman said the company was in the process of hiring a new president for the Energy Services unit and was trying to lower the unit's operating costs by cutting about 25 job cuts, effective March 1.
The spokesman said it was too early to make an estimate as to the moves' impact on the unit, which contributes a little less than one-third of CNG's total annual revenue.
